message: AMP for Email input is not compiled
hint: td;dr compiles the text/html part of an email. AMP for Email goes in its own text/x-amp-html MIME part next to it; compile a plain HTML version of the message here.
The online copy (view in browser) shows the <title> in its tab, and a screen reader says it first. Add a <title> to the <head>; a component can write one in its markup.
